context: 15 Sep gave back the prior day's whole positive move -- 'as much positive momentum as came a day before, that much selling has already happened'. The market is ALREADY negative, so POSITIONAL SELLERS are now seated and in profit.
plan: THE PLAN IS CONDITIONAL ON THE OPEN, inverting yesterday's all-buy note: a good GAP UP means BUY, FLAT or GAP DOWN means SELL. He repeats it for all three indices, so the open picks the side before any setup is read.

GAP UP -> BUY, because the gap traps the seated sellers: 'the market is already negative and made good momentum today too, so there can be POSITIONAL sellers here -- if we get a good gap up we CAN target these sellers'.
FLAT OR GAP DOWN -> SELL, and the reason is the ABSENCE of a target rather than weakness: 'they will already be sitting in confidence so we cannot target them -- there we must go WITH the market'.

A GAP DOWN IS THE EASY CASE, NOT A WARNING: 'if a gap down opens that is a very good thing, because momentum is already good, so walking with the market will be easy'. Flat is fine too -- 'in flat there is no problem either'.

TARGET THE LATE SELLERS, NOT THE EARLY ONES: 'the upper-side seller we cannot make our target, but those sitting having SOLD HERE can be targeted'. The cohort that sold into today's lows is the marginal one.

SELLERS IN PROFIT CANNOT BE HUNTED QUICKLY: 'the sellers will come into some profit, and second, confidence will stay inside them, so we cannot make a target quickly'. Profit plus confidence is what removes them as prey.
